title: Accumulator Operations Reference Sheet: Pharmacy Benefit Plan Settings by Design
content:
The deductible and out-of-pocket accumulators of a Pharmacy Benefit Plan enrollment are fed from more than pharmacy claims. Six design settings govern what else feeds them and for how long.

| Plan design | Accumulator integration | Medical feed interval (calendar days) | Copay-assistance program | Prior-carrier credit | Prior-carrier statement window (calendar days after coverage effective date) | Prior-year correction window (calendar days after the plan year's last day) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Rx HSA Saver | Integrated with medical | 1 | Accumulator adjustment | Yes | 90 | 90 |
| Northbridge Rx Basic | Separate pharmacy-only | 0 (no feed) | Accumulator adjustment | Yes | 60 | 90 |
| Northbridge Rx Value | Integrated with medical | 1 | Standard | Yes | 60 | 90 |
| Northbridge Rx Select | Separate pharmacy-only | 0 (no feed) | Standard | Yes | 90 | 120 |
| Northbridge Rx Plus | Integrated with medical | 7 | Standard | Yes | 90 | 120 |
| Northbridge Rx Premier | Separate pharmacy-only | 0 (no feed) | Standard | Yes | 120 | 180 |

## What each setting means

- **Accumulator integration.** *Integrated with medical*: the deductible and out-of-pocket are shared with the sponsor's medical carrier, whose amounts are fed in. *Separate pharmacy-only*: the accumulators are pharmacy-only.
- **Medical feed interval.** The number of calendar days between inbound medical-carrier accumulator feeds; 0 means there is no feed, which is the case on every separate pharmacy-only design.
- **Copay-assistance program.** *Standard*: manufacturer copay-assistance payments count toward the deductible and out-of-pocket. *Accumulator adjustment*: only the member's own payments count.
- **Prior-carrier credit.** Deductible and out-of-pocket already met under a prior pharmacy carrier in the same plan year are credited on takeover; every design has this feature.
- **Prior-carrier statement window.** The number of calendar days after the coverage effective date within which the prior carrier's accumulator statement must be received to be credited.
- **Prior-year correction window.** The number of calendar days after the last day of a plan year during which that plan year's accumulators may still be corrected.

## Quick contrasts

- Medical amounts reach the accumulators daily on Northbridge Rx HSA Saver and Northbridge Rx Value, every 7 days on Northbridge Rx Plus, and never on Northbridge Rx Basic, Select or Premier.
- Only Northbridge Rx HSA Saver and Northbridge Rx Basic run accumulator adjustment.
- The prior-carrier statement window runs from 60 days (Northbridge Rx Basic and Value) to 120 days (Northbridge Rx Premier); the prior-year correction window runs from 90 days to 180 days.
